title: Space-Time Duality of Diffusion via Subordination: General Theory and Relativistic Models
summary: The Cattaneo-Vernotte model and the relativistic Schrödinger operator represent two fundamental frameworks for the relativistic modifications of normal diffusion, leading to the telegraph equation and a class of spatially nonlocal diffusion equations, respectively. This paper investigates the intrinsic connection between these two relativistic diffusion models. While it is well-established that spatially non-local diffusion arises from subordinating normal diffusion, we reveal a novel reciprocal mechanism: the normal diffusion process can be recovered by subordinating the telegraph process…
